purpose: Diagnostic extension after the original 11-command JDI initialization; panel/board reception unverified
notes: 51 FF 00 matches the public driver's 8-bit brightness carried in a u16. 53 24 requests BCTRL and BL on without dimming. This test sends both over LPDT; the public driver uses HS for brightness. It does not drive an unidentified external backlight GPIO.
